# Archway Business Brokers

> Archway Business Brokers supports owners selling or transferring operating businesses in Vietnam with annual revenue from VND 3 billion.

## About

Archway Business Brokers is a Vietnam-focused business brokerage service for owners preparing a confidential sale or transfer of an operating business.

The service helps owners prepare information, approach suitable buyers and coordinate the transaction process.

Initial discussions are free, and a discussion creates no obligation for either party.

## Criteria

- Businesses operating in Vietnam.
- Operating businesses with annual revenue from VND 3 billion.
- Owners considering a sale or transfer.
- Buyers seeking operating businesses in Vietnam.
